blind_target.authors: Roberts, S. C., Little, A. C., Burriss, R. P., Cobey, K. D., Klapilová, K., Havlíček, J., et al.
blind_target.title: Partner choice, relationship satisfaction, and oral contraception: The congruency hypothesis.
blind_target.evidence_quote: Despite using exactly the same measures as used in all previous studies except one (Russell et al., 2014) as well as additional, well-validated alternative measures, we were unable to confirm the results concerning sexual satisfaction reported by Roberts, Little, et al. (2014) and Russell et al. (2014), or the results concerning jealousy reported by Cobey et al. (2013).
blind_target.outcome_quote: Despite using exactly the same measures as used in all previous studies except one (Russell et al., 2014) as well as additional, well-validated alternative measures, we were unable to confirm the results concerning sexual satisfaction reported by Roberts, Little, et al. (2014) and Russell et al. (2014), or the results concerning jealousy reported by Cobey et al. (2013).
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: The authors explicitly report failure to confirm the central finding of each of these three original papers. The Russell test includes a conceptual test of the attractiveness moderator.
